parts.name: Aggressive Widebody Kit
parts.note: Requires fender cutting/fabrication on BP-chassis hatch — not a bolt-on.

parts.name: Front Splitter
parts.note: Bolts to most aftermarket or stock front bumpers.

parts.name: Rear Diffuser
parts.note: Fits stock rear bumper, most aftermarket options.

parts.name: Adjustable GT Wing
parts.note: May require trunk drilling/reinforcement — hatch mounting differs from sedan.

parts.name: Duckbill Spoiler
parts.note: Direct bolt-on, low downforce.

parts.name: 18x9.5 / 18x10.5 Forged Wheels (square)
parts.note: Rear fitment on stock-width fenders requires the widebody kit or fender rolling.

parts.name: Full Satin/Gloss Wrap + Livery
parts.note: No fitment dependency — cosmetic only.

parts.name: Underglow + Darkened Lighting
parts.note: Underglow is off-road/show-only in most jurisdictions.

parts.name: Bucket Seats + 4-Point Harnesses
parts.note: Harness bar or cage mounting point required for correct harness angle.

parts.name: Half Cage
parts.note: Chassis-specific mounting kit needed — confirm hatch vs sedan chassis points.

parts.name: Cold Air Intake
parts.note: Minimal gain in isolation on stock turbo/NA setup.

parts.name: Full Turbo-Back Exhaust
parts.note: Loud — track/show only in most areas.

parts.name: Upgraded Intercooler
parts.note: Foundation mod, supports later boost increases.

parts.name: Larger Turbo Kit (hybrid/upgrade)
parts.note: Mazda 3 aftermarket turbo support is thinner than WRX/GTI-class platforms — expect semi-custom fabrication.

parts.name: Upgraded Fuel Pump + Injectors
parts.note: Required supporting mod once boost/power target exceeds stock fuel delivery.

parts.name: Standalone ECU / Tune
parts.note: Mazda Skyactiv tuning support is more limited than Subaru/VW ecosystems — verify tuner availability first.

parts.name: Stronger Clutch
parts.note: Required once torque exceeds stock clutch rating.

parts.name: Nitrous Kit
parts.note: Low real-world documentation on this platform — treat gain range as low-confidence.

parts.name: Fully Adjustable Coilovers
parts.note: Well-supported on this platform.

parts.name: Sway Bars + Camber Arms
parts.note: Direct bolt-on across generations.

parts.name: Big Brake Kit (F+R)
parts.note: Confirm caliper clearance against the specific wheel size chosen.
